gates.evidence: Proposal targets Settings (s19) and SFW interactions.
Reward is in-app time (30 minutes of Upgrade to Luzia+); no cash, gift cards, or install incentives.
Copy uses positive framing ('Play to try') with a clear decline ('No thanks').
Offer uses an explicit 'Play to try' button.
Offer states the exact action and reward: 'Play a 15-second game to unlock 30 minutes of Upgrade to Luzia+'.
Decline option ('No thanks') leaves Settings fully usable without penalty.
Trigger sits in Settings (s19), away from any streaming AI response.

scores.evidence: Tying the ad directly to the 'Upgrade to Luzia+' upsell in Settings gives users who tapped the premium feature an immediate try via a game sample.
Appears in Settings rather than mid-chat, preserving the user's roleplay and input flow.
Time-boxes the unlock to 30 minutes, caps it at 2 per day, restricts it to non-subscribers, and provides a holdout.
Cost to serve is $0.0000 (none), well below net revenue per view.
Settings is a frequent hub (m12, m19), but tapping Upgrade to Luzia+ from settings is a narrower subset of DAU.
Maps to SIM-RWD with button entry, REWARD_VERIFIED, and remote config.
Cites obs o0060 ('Upgrade to Luzia+'), screen s19, resource r1, and moments m23/m1.
Caps at 2 per day with a 60-minute cooldown.
Defines primary metric, guardrails, and a 10% user-level holdout.

parsed.topConcern: Ensure users understand that the 30-minute time-boxed unlock of a subscription entitlement expires clearly so it does not dilute the perceived value of full Luzia+ subscription.
